verdict.rationale: Vanta's API documents creating custom controls alongside library controls (add from library, deactivate a custom or Vanta control, update metadata). Documents can be mapped to controls as evidence, and Custom Tests turn pushed resource data into pass/fail evidence. Custom frameworks appear only as marketing copy about cross-mapping across pre-built frameworks "or ones you've customized" and bringing your existing program into Vanta. missing for 10: first-party docs on creating fully custom frameworks (not just customizing pre-built ones), explicit docs on defining per-control evidence requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration.
